people.text: Amal and her family want to have a day out at a museum. Amal hopes to see inside an old ship, and the family need somewhere for Amal's small brother to play.
Niall hopes to watch a film about transport methods around the world and learn how transport might change in the future. He'd like to buy something to remind him of his trip.
Kazue wants to learn about the history of trains and to know more about the people who work on important transport projects. Her family hope to have a picnic during the visit.
Dariusz wants to know about early space travel and to find out about working in the airline industry. His family don't have a car, so need to visit a city centre museum.
Esme and her dad want to do a museum tour with a guide and to see some old racing cars. Esme wants to experience what it's like to drive a train.

items.label: A
items.title: Central Transport Museum
items.text: If you're concerned about the planet, don't miss the Next Steps exhibition, all about how we can improve in the years ahead. The exhibition includes videos about transport used in other countries, from bikes to high-speed trains, and cards in the shop make fantastic souvenirs.

items.label: B
items.title: The Talbot
items.text: This place has loads to entertain for the whole day, including a garden where little ones can run around. The latest exhibit is a large, life - size boat in incredible condition – find out what life on board was like as you visit. It transported goods worldwide, and you can imagine racing across the seas!

items.label: C
items.title: Transport Hub
items.text: The great thing about this museum is that its displays change frequently. Currently, visitors can discover the work involved in planning city transport systems, and a future exhibit will be "space travel", concentrating on technology in modern rockets. The gift shop has interesting things to buy too.

items.label: D
items.title: All about Transport
items.text: This museum's perfect for the whole family, with guided tours aimed at younger visitors. You can watch a film about the world's most beautiful train rides and learn how engineers build the bridges and tunnels that keep traffic moving!

items.label: E
items.title: Garston Place
items.text: Just inside the entrance, don't miss displays about those design, build and run international city transport systems, like airports or ports. The hall has an exhibition about the start of the rail industry, with videos of early passenger trains. There are tables outside if you're bringing food – there's lots of space for active kids!

items.label: F
items.title: Explore!
items.text: This museum has something for everyone, and it's worth booking to go round with an expert. We've got a section on motor - racing history, with early record - breaking vehicles on display and the chance to operate the controls of a real train, travelling along a track! It's not suitable for young children, but you'll remember the experience for years.

items.label: G
items.title: Marley's Museum
items.text: With a convenient location not far from the city centre, it's easy to spend several hours in this small museum. Listen to interviews with people talking about transport - related jobs everything from plots to cruise ship captains! You'll also see plans for the first space rockets and learn about problems engineers faced.

items.label: H
items.title: Herston Museum of Transport
items.text: If you're interested in how transport could change the future of the world, then you'll love this place. Everyone, young or old, will enjoy the interactive video games. Race a super - car, or be in charge of a spaceship! Don't miss the café – buy a cake to eat in the museum garden.

explanations.6: Amal 想参观能看到旧船内部的博物馆，家人需为弟弟提供玩耍空间。B 选项 “The Talbot” 有大型真人大小的船展览，可了解船上生活，还有花园供小孩奔跑，符合需求。原文 “latest exhibit is a large, life-size boat... garden where little ones can run around” 对应 “old ship inside, place for brother to play”。
explanations.7: Niall 想观看关于全球交通方式的电影，了解未来交通变化，买纪念品。A 选项 “Central Transport Museum” 的 “Next Steps” 展览有各国交通视频，商店里的卡片可作精美纪念品，符合需求。原文 “videos about transport used in other countries... cards in the shop make fantastic souvenirs” 对应 “film about transport, future changes, buy something”。
explanations.8: Kazue 想了解火车历史和重要交通项目工作人员，家人希望参观时野餐。E 选项 “Garston Place” 有铁路工业起源展览和早期客运列车视频，室外有桌子供野餐，符合需求。原文 “exhibition about the start of the rail industry... tables outside if you're bringing food” 对应 “history of trains, people on transport projects, picnic”。
explanations.9: Dariusz 想了解早期太空旅行和航空业工作，家人没车需参观市中心博物馆。G 选项 “Marley's Museum” 位于市中心附近，有早期太空火箭计划和飞行员、邮轮船长等交通相关工作的采访，符合需求。原文 “convenient location not far from the city centre... interviews with people talking about transport-related jobs... first space rockets” 对应 “early space travel, airline industry, city centre”。
explanations.10: Esme 和爸爸想参加有导游的博物馆之旅，看老式赛车，Esme 想体验驾驶火车。F 选项 “Explore!” 提供专家导游团，有赛车历史展区和操作真实火车控制装置的机会，符合需求。原文 “book to go round with an expert... section on motor-racing history... operate the controls of a real train” 对应 “guided tour, old racing cars, drive a train”。
